data.summary: PMP Certified Program Manager with more than 15+ yrs of exp with global Top 5 clients such as Citi Bank, OpenBank, AT&T, Chevron and many more.

soft_skills: Ability to complete tasks well before schedule
all_skills: Ability to complete tasks well before schedule

responsibilities: Led the enterprise-wide implementation of AI-powered fraud detection and prevention capabilities across Citi Bank's digital payments ecosystem, leveraging machine learning models to identify suspicious transactions in real time.

Directed the end-to-end lifecycle of integrating advanced machine learning models into the core banking switch, enabling real-time identification and blocking of suspicious transactions with a latency of under 200 milliseconds.
Delivered a projected $15M+ in annual savings by proactively detecting fraudulent patterns, significantly reducing chargebacks, operational charge-offs, and customer reimbursement liabilities.

Drove a 30% reduction in false positive alerts by optimizing ML model parameters and refining threshold rules, which minimized unnecessary transaction declines and reduced manual fraud analyst review workloads by 25%.

Ensured 100% adherence to U.S. consumer protection regulations (Regulation E and Fair Credit Billing Act) by establishing robust model validation frameworks, audit trails, and transparent consumer alert protocols.

Orchestrated collaboration between Data Science, Core Engineering, Operations, and Legal/Compliance teams to align technical deliverables with business objectives, successfully delivering Phase 1 of the initiative 10% ahead of the projected timeline.

Acted as the primary liaison to Executive Steering Committees, translating complex model performance metrics (AUC-ROC, precision/recall) into actionable business insights to secure continued funding and board approval for subsequent rollout phases.
Redesigned legacy fraud escalation workflows to accommodate new AI-driven insights, cutting average investigation resolution time by 40% and improving overall case management efficiency.

Led the enterprise-wide migration of Citi Bank's customer-facing applications to a hybrid cloud architecture (AWS + private cloud), modernizing legacy systems through containerization and cloud-native practices.

Directed the end-to-end migration lifecycle of critical customer-facing applications to hybrid cloud platforms, establishing a scalable, future-ready architecture aligned with Citi's digital transformation roadmap.

Defined program scope, multi-phase migration roadmap, success KPIs, and risk mitigation strategies—orchestrating seamless transition of high-priority workloads while ensuring zero customer-impact downtime.

Ensured 100% adherence to PCI-DSS and U.S. financial regulations by establishing robust security controls, encryption protocols, data governance frameworks, and comprehensive audit trails throughout the migration journey.

Oversaw pilot migrations with rigorous performance benchmarking, validated system resilience and application readiness, and successfully scaled the solution across multiple portfolios—achieving a 20% reduction in infrastructure costs and 99.99% system uptime.
Managed strategic vendor relationships for cloud infrastructure, containerization tools, and professional services, negotiating contracts and ensuring delivery against SLAs and program milestones.

Served as the primary liaison to Executive Steering Committees and Board-level sponsors, translating technical migration metrics into clear business value propositions to secure continued funding and organizational buy-in.
Led organizational change initiatives to drive cloud-native adoption across development teams, implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to accelerate feature releases and innovation cycles.
Led the enterprise-wide Green Banking initiative to digitize paper-based processes and embed ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) compliance into Citi Bank's retail banking operations.

Directed the end-to-end implementation of digital transformation initiatives across retail banking operations, replacing paper-intensive processes with sustainable digital alternatives to reduce environmental footprint and operational costs.

Embedded ESG compliance frameworks into customer-facing banking operations, establishing sustainability metrics and reporting mechanisms to align with Citi Bank's corporate social responsibility goals.

Led the rollout of e-statements and digital documentation across retail banking, driving a 40% reduction in paper consumption while improving customer accessibility and satisfaction through seamless digital experiences.
Digitized legacy paper-based workflows, automating document processing and storage—achieving a 30% reduction in operational costs and significantly improving processing turnaround times.

Ensured 100% alignment with emerging ESG regulatory requirements and Citi Bank's internal sustainability mandates by establishing robust governance frameworks, reporting dashboards, and audit-ready documentation.

Orchestrated collaboration across Retail Banking, Operations, IT, Sustainability, Legal, and Marketing teams to align program deliverables with enterprise ESG strategy and customer experience objectives.

Served as the primary liaison to Executive Steering Committees and ESG governance boards, translating sustainability metrics into clear business value propositions to secure continued funding and organizational buy-in.

Led organizational change initiatives to drive digital adoption across branches and customer touchpoints, implementing training programs and communication strategies to ensure seamless transition to paperless banking.

Led the enterprise-wide replacement of Citi Bank's legacy, on-premise Card Management System with a modern, cloud-enabled platform to drive product agility, reduce operational costs, and ensure compliance with evolving regulatory standards.

Directed the end-to-end lifecycle of replacing the legacy card management platform with a cloud-enabled, modern architecture, establishing a scalable, future-ready system to accelerate product innovation and enhance customer experience.

Orchestrated the seamless migration of 2 million active credit and debit card portfolios to the new cloud platform, ensuring zero data loss, zero transaction disruptions, and 100% data integrity throughout the transition.

Enabled new digital-first capabilities including instant virtual card issuance, dynamic currency conversion, and customizable transaction limits via mobile app, significantly enhancing customer convenience and competitive positioning.
Achieved 100% PCI-DSS 4.0 compliance by establishing robust security controls, encryption protocols, data governance frameworks, and comprehensive audit trails throughout the modernization journey.

Delivered a 30% reduction in annual system maintenance costs by decommissioning legacy infrastructure and transitioning to cloud-native, scalable platform with automated updates and reduced operational overhead.

Orchestrated collaboration across IT, Cloud Engineering, Card Operations, Product, Security, Compliance, and Customer Service teams to align technical deliverables with business objectives and ensure seamless program execution.
Managed strategic vendor relationships for cloud infrastructure, platform implementation, and professional services, negotiating contracts and ensuring delivery against SLAs and program milestones.

Served as the primary liaison to Executive Steering Committees and Board-level sponsors, translating technical migration metrics and business outcomes into clear value propositions to secure continued funding and organizational buy-in.

Led comprehensive training and change management initiatives across Operations, Customer Service, and IT teams, ensuring 100% stakeholder readiness and seamless adoption of the new platform prior to go-live.

Established robust rollback strategies, disaster recovery protocols, and rigorous UAT (User Acceptance Testing) to mitigate migration risks and ensure uninterrupted customer transactions throughout the transition.

Led Agile delivery of digital wallet enablement and card-on-file tokenization across Citi Bank's 50M+ credit and debit card portfolio, modernizing the payment experience and accelerating digital adoption.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to ensure iterative progress across migration, integration, compliance, and feature enablement workstreams.

Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Payments, IT Security, Compliance, Risk, Customer Experience, and Merchant Partnerships) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental features aligned with PCI CP standards and U.S. regulations (Reg E, Reg Z).

Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for universal tokenization, ensuring seamless provisioning of cards into Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, and merchant platforms such as Amazon and PayPal.
Oversaw sprint-based technical integration with Visa Token Service (VTS) and Mastercard Digital Enablement Service (MDES), ensuring zero disruption during migration from legacy provisioning systems.
Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for large-scale tokenization and wallet adoption.
Developed training and enablement materials to prepare operations, customer service, and IT teams for supporting digital wallet transactions and dispute resolution processes.
Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor delivery progress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.

Delivered measurable outcomes, increasing contactless transaction volume by 40%, growing active mobile wallet users by 5 million within 12 months, and positioning Citi Bank as a leader in secure, compliant digital payments.
Led Agile delivery of cheque guarantee functionality within the T24 Core Banking system, enabling secure initiation, cancellation, stop payments, and non-payment handling of certified cheques.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to ensure iterative progress across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.

Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Core Banking, Payments, Compliance, Risk, and Operations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental enhancements aligned with Openbank Spain's regulatory and customer requirements.
Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless handling of suspense accounts, guarantee validity periods, and customer account reconciliation.
Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for high-value cheque transactions.
Developed training and enablement materials for operations and customer service teams, ensuring adoption of new cheque guarantee processes and compliance with banking standards.
Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor progress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.

Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening transaction security, improving customer trust in certified cheques, and aligning with Openbank Spain's commitment to robust and efficient digital banking operations.
Led Agile delivery of compliance enhancements in the T24 Core Banking system to enforce Spanish Tax Authority rules on joint accounts and deposits.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to drive iterative progress across requirement validation, system design, development, and testing.
Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Core Banking, Compliance, Risk, IT, and Operations) to prioritize backlog items and ensure regulatory alignment.
Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for residency validation, ensuring the system correctly restricted joint accounts to either all residents or all non-residents.
Managed sprint-based system integration and testing activities, validating error messages and exception handling for mixed residency scenarios.
Partnered with stakeholders and vendors to ensure solution design adhered to compliance standards and operational workflows.

Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening regulatory compliance, improving operational accuracy, and safeguarding customer trust in Openbank Spain's account management processes.
Led Agile delivery of BBAN-based account verification functionality within Openbank Spain's T24 Core Banking system, reducing documentation overhead and streamlining background checks.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to ensure iterative progress across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.

Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Core Banking, Compliance, IT Security, and Operations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental enhancements aligned with Spanish interbank standards.
Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for handling both incoming verification requests from participating banks and outgoing requests initiated by Openbank.
Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless API communication and accurate validation of account verification status across interbank networks.
Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for real-time verification.
Developed training and enablement materials for operations and customer service teams, ensuring adoption of new verification processes and compliance with regulatory requirements.
Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening interbank collaboration, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing customer trust in Openbank Spain's account verification services.
Led Agile delivery of Deposit Interest Retention Tax (DIRT) compliance enhancements within Bank International Luxembourg's core banking systems, ensuring accurate tax deduction and reporting.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to drive iterative progress across requirement gathering, system design, development, and testing.
Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Tax Compliance, Core Banking, IT, Risk, and Operations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental features aligned with regulatory mandates.
Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for automated DIRT calculation at 41%, withholding before interest payments, and mandatory reporting to Revenue when thresholds were exceeded.
Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless reconciliation between customer accounts, tax reporting modules, and regulatory systems.
Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for tax compliance.
Developed training and enablement materials for operations and customer service teams to ensure adoption of new tax reporting processes and compliance with income tax standards.
Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor delivery progress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.

Delivered measurable outcomes, reducing manual overhead, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving transparency in customer tax obligations, and safeguarding Bank International Luxembourg's adherence to reporting standards.

Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to drive iterative progress across requirement gathering, system design, development, and testing.

Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless processing across loan origination, approval, and disbursement modules while maintaining compliance with consumer protection laws.
Partnered with stakeholders and vendors to validate solution design, conduct proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for 24/7 loan servicing.
